statement_blocker: The repository supplies only the convolutional-neural-network label and the gloss neural networks for image processing. It fixes no architecture, input and image model, convolution or cross-correlation convention, padding, stride, activation, pooling, task, loss, training semantics, data distribution, hypotheses, ordered binders, or conclusion. Selecting a finite layer identity, LeNet instance, equivariance, approximation, optimization, generalization, robustness, or empirical-recognition result would invent proposition-changing mathematics.
